name: Sergey Valeryevich AKSYONOV
alias: Sergei Valerievich AKSENOV; Serhiy Valeriyovych AKSYONOV; Сергей Валерьевич AKCëHOB; Сергiй Валерiйович Аксьонов
reason: Aksyonov was elected ‘Prime Minister of Crimea’ in the Crimean Verkhovna Rada on 27 February 2014 in the presence of pro-Russian gunmen.
